newsitem.title: POLAND: MERRILL LYNCH TO BUY 8 MLN BIG SHARES.
newsitem.headline: MERRILL LYNCH TO BUY 8 MLN BIG SHARES.

text.p: Merrill Lynch International plans on August 14 to make use of its option to buy eight million shares of Bank Inicjatyw Gospodarczych SA (BIG), Bank Gdanski, with which BIG is merging, said on Friday.
Gdanski said in a statement on Friday the shares would serve as a basis for extending BIG's global depositary receipt (GDR) programme but gave no further details.
In late July, Merrill Lynch signed an agreement with BIG under which it would buy 60 percent of BIG's three million GDRs, which represent 45 million of BIG's recent 65-million-share issue.
Revenues from the issue are to be used to cover costs of the takeover of Gdanski, of which BIG now holds 63.4 percent.
Bank Gdanski must sell its whole stake in BIG SA for it be taken over by BIG, a process seen finished by October.
